search_window.basis: Previous actual completed_at confirmed through authenticated GitHub readback. Search for newly reported/discovered developments since that timestamp; exclude previously recorded incidents. Run began before nominal hourly scheduled minute, using the actual observation interval.

discovery_context.duplicates_checked: Prior authenticated 06:47 PST heartbeat excluded earlier Jabalia incident and previous Nasser Hospital, flooding, cold and aid reports. WAFA story ID 176924 and 17:23 publication not in prior heartbeat.
